name: hcapp_setEventRsvp
description: Sets RSVP state and/or hare designation for a hasher at an event. Creates a new HEM record if none exists. Blocks updates when the user is already checked in (attendenceState >= 20) and the RSVP state would change. Automatically sets notification prefs when @autoSetNotifications=1. Updates Event.Hares string on hare state change. Returns adHoc data + delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Hasher to set RSVP for. Defaults to calling user if null.

parameters.name: isHare
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (don't update). When @rsvpState=1 (not coming), forced to 0.

parameters.name: rsvpState
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Known values: 1=not coming, 2=maybe, 3=coming.

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Direct HEM lookup. Must match @eventId — mismatch returns error.

parameters.name: autoSetNotifications
parameters.description: Default 1. When 1, automatically sets notification prefs: rsvpState=1 → prefs=2, otherwise reads from HKM.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId, null eventId, mismatched hemId/eventId. errorType=3 for auth failure.

rowsets.name: AdHocRsvpResult
rowsets.description: Single row returned on all non-error paths (including no-change paths).

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: Empty string on success. Human-readable reason when RSVP could not be changed (user checked in, no state change, etc.).

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: Current rsvpState after update (re-read from DB).

columns.name: willHareState
columns.description: Current isHare after update (re-read from DB).

columns.name: hares
columns.description: Updated Event.Hares string. NULL if @isHare did not change.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET RsvpState, IsHare, EventNotificationPreference, EventEmailAlertPreference — when conditions met
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when no existing HEM record
UPDATE HC.Event SET hares — when hare state changes (STRING_AGG)

codeSmells.issue: Complex update condition — may silently skip update
codeSmells.detail: The UPDATE only fires when a complex multi-branch condition is true. If all branches evaluate false (e.g. state unchanged, user checked in), the SP returns an adHoc row with a serverMessage explaining why — but the caller gets a 200 with no error, just a message to display.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change rsvpState integer codes without updating all callers
